subject: general
question: Keshav's salary is ₹13,000 per month. He spends ₹4,000 on house rent, ₹1,500 on bills and the rest of the amount is his monthly savings. Find his savings (in) in a year, if in the month of his birthday, he spent his complete monthly savings for the birthday celebration.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Monthly Savings** = 13000 − (4000 + 1500) = ₹7500.

**Savings Months** = 12 − 1 (birthday month) = 11 months.

**Total Annual Savings** = 7500 × 11 = ₹82,500.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹82,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bc94486c23ce4daf46c6381adf3629315ba40e66ed2e379a62e49be96802c9b.png] 

**Given:**

Monthly Salary = ₹13,000

Expenditure on Rent = ₹4,000

Expenditure on Bills = ₹1,500

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Monthly Savings** = Total Salary − (Rent + Bills)

⇒ **Monthly Savings** = 13,000 − (4,000 + 1,500) = 13,000 − 5,500 = ₹7,500

⇒ In the **birthday month**, savings are spent, so net savings for that month = ₹0.

⇒ Number of months with **actual savings** = 12 − 1 = 11 months.

⇒ **Total Annual Savings** = 11 × 7,500

⇒ **Total Annual Savings** = ₹82,500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹82,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure and Savings

The basic relationship is **Income = Expenditure + Savings**. To find savings, subtract all expenses from the total income.

Annual Calculation

Always identify the number of effective months where the condition applies. **Annual Total = Monthly Value × Number of Months**.

Percentage Savings

Savings % = (Savings ÷ Income) × 100. In this case, monthly savings % ≈ 57.69%.
